sketch.name: PlantStatusGrid
sketch.description: A compact status board of ethanol plants: one tile per plant with its status, run rate against nameplate and a 3rd-party badge, grouped by region or ownership under a fleet summary.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: How the tiles are grouped: by region, by ownership (owned / 3rd-party), or not at all.

props.name: selected
props.description: The id of the selected plant; empty for none.

props.name: plants
props.description: The plants: { id, name, region, owned, status (running | reduced | down | turnaround), capacityMmgy, runRatePct, productionKgal }.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no designer-edited items): plants are data rows, set from code as any list of objects (PlantStatusGridPlant on the server). Docked inside a GridBoard widget: no outer border or card chrome; fluid from about 300x200 to 1000x500, the tile area scrolls. Status colours: running = positive, reduced = warning (amber), down = negative, turnaround = accent (planned). 3P badge marks 3rd-party plants. Tooltip on hover: capacity MMgy, today's kgal, status. Summary: counts by status and fleet run rate = sum(capacity × run rate) / sum(capacity). Colours follow the GridKrafter palette (same tokens as CrushMarginGauge).
